task: Task 1 spec check — slugify diff against the settled slug rule

acceptance.expect: judged by reading only — you have no shell by design, so leave commands_rerun empty

constraints: Reachability: the change is confined to src/slugify.py and tests/test_slugify.py, so reading those two files plus the implementer brief is the full evidence set.
Judge only plan compliance: does the diff implement the settled slug rule, and does the test suite actually assert it? Quality and defect hunting belong to a different validator.
The settled slug rule: lowercase; every non-ASCII-alphanumeric character is a separator; each run of separators collapses to one hyphen; leading and trailing hyphens are stripped.
commands_rerun MUST be empty. You have no shell; a non-empty list means the roles were combined.
Check specifically that a test asserts slugify('Hello,  World!') == 'hello-world', and that the six required cases from the implementer brief are covered.
expected_result: PASS if the diff implements the settled slug rule and the suite asserts it, including the six required cases. Otherwise FINDINGS naming each gap against the brief.
